title: Tempered Paradox Needle
text: Upgrade the preceding weapon at the Advanced Assembly Table. Damage, enchantments, custom names and the inserted spell crystal are preserved.
Upgrade 3: 14 damage, 2.1 attack speed, 21 total healing and 175% base special range. Paradox motes increase with level.
